 Grand Theft Auto VI Choices Guide 
 Blaine Smith 2 seconds ago Facebook X Reddit WhatsApp Telegram GTA 6 is full of choices, moments where Lucia and Jason can change events and relationships throughout the story. In this choices guide, we list all of the choices we’ve discovered in the game and the outcomes of the decisions you make.
 How To Use This Guide
 GTA 6 choices are often worded the same way, for example, Jason and Lucia will have multiple choices where they can Accept or Decline, which makes finding the right choice difficult.
 When you are faced with a choice, write part of the choice in the box below. This will bring up related choices. You can also try typing one of the characters’ names into the search box as well.
 Alternatively, the choices are listed in order of Chapter, so you’re less likely to spoil something if you just browse manually.
 WARNING: This is a choices guide that spreads throughout the entire story. There will be spoilers. We will only provide the exact information needed to help you make the decision, and will not spoil unnecessary events. 
 We have made sure this article will not appear on the homepage, so there should be no risk of accidental discovery.
 Choices Search Shoot Or Spare Arnold
 During the Hey Arnold mission in Chapter 1, Jason chases down Arnold and the two eventually arrive on a dock. Jason is then given the choice on how to deal with the situation. He can either choose to kill Arnold or spare him.
 If You Kill Arnold 
 Jason kills Arnold and you get an Aggressive bonus.
 If You Spare Arnold 
 You get a Restrained bonus and Jason tells Arnold he’ll find him if he talks. Arnold then jumps into the sea and swims away.
 Much later in the game, during Chapter IV, Brian will message Jason or Lucia and tell them he bumped into Arnold. He forgives Arnold, now that they are both old and retired, and sends Jason & Lucia $10,000 as a thank you for letting him live.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Shoot Kirk Or The Skunk Ape
 If You Shoot The Skunk Ape 
 If you wait to shoot the Skunk Ape until it wakes up, threatening Kirk in the process, he will promise to cut you in. You get $10,000 cash on BuckMe.
 Afterwards, Kirk takes off but the helicopter crash lands killing both him and the pilot. Skunk Ape is nowhere to be found.
 If You Shoot Kirk 
 Will update soon.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Shake Or Don’t Shake Mattias’ Hand
 We didn’t notice any difference in future events
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Accept Or Refuse Drugs From Mattias 
 Accept 
 Accept the drugs from Mattias. This makes the next events of the game more trippy.
 Refuse 
 The following events are more normal
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Hold Hands With Lucia On The Balcony Or Not 
 When Jason and Lucia go to jump from the balcony to the pool. You get a reduction/increase to the relationship depending on your choice.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Mention Brian’s Retirement Or Don’t 
 After you rescue Brian’s Wife and return home with Lucia. If you mention it, their relationship improves; if you don’t, the relationship will suffer later in the story, after you take Cal fishing and Lucia finds out.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Eat The Mutated Strawberry Or Refuse
 Eat The Mutated Strawberry 
It provides a buff to Health, Stamina, and Focus, permanently increases Stamina, and replenishes Health. No downsides.
 Refuse The Mutated Strawberry 
You don’t eat the strawberry
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Help The Dancers Or Don’t
 Help The Dancers 
 If you help the dancers, Jason has a scene on the stage where you dance alongside the other dancers, members of the audience, and eventually Lucia. It offers a slightly stealthier approach with some fun thrown in.
 Don’t Help The Dancers 
 The other dancers walk out, and Frankie is forced to come out and do a show by himself. The audience isn’t happy about it. This is the more aggressive approach to the mission.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Take The Play Money From Dre’Quan Or Don’t
 Take The Money From Dre’Quan 
 Jason and Lucia can interact with the dancers in the club and throw money around at them
 Decline Money From Dre’Quan 
 Jason and Lucia get straight to business, skipping the scene interacting with the clubs staff
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Choose The Pure Or Cut Product
 During Chapter III of Grand Theft Auto VI, Jason meets Tyrone and is given the choice of buying some product to sell on the streets.
 The choice here is either a cheaper, lower-quality product or a more expensive, higher-quality product. It says Jason will make a lot more profit from the lower-quality product than the higher-quality product.
 If You Choose Cut Product 
 When Jason tries to sell the product, the buyer tests it. Jason can then either agree to sell it at half price or max price. If you choose max price, you need to fight your way out and escape the police.
 If You Choose Pure Product 
 Jason and Dre’Quan head to a meet and sell the product. One of the buyers associates gets into the car to check the quality of the product. You get a Professional rating boost for handling the deal properly. This is the best choice.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Give Or Reject Giving The Statue To Benedict Halifax
 During Chapter III of Grand Theft Auto VI, Jason and Lucia are given a choice when taking a statue to get appraised at an antique dealers.
As they leave the establishment they are approached by Benedict Halifax, who offers to investigate the statue to verify its authenticity and potential value. In exchange, he offers to let Jason and Lucia keep his watch.
 If You Choose Give 
Jason agrees and takes the watch from Benedict Halifax, giving him the statue. The group agree to stay in touch and keep it quiet. You have to wait a LONG time before this progresses. Eventually, Jason and Lucia will seek out Halifax after not hearing from him for some time.
 When you track him down, you get another choice
 If You Choose Trust Halifax 
 Lucia tells Halifax they will be watching him, and he promises to call first thing the next day.
 Later you learn that Halifax is a con artist and he has the statue stowed away somewhere. You get it back and then deal with Angela to sell it.
 You get a stash bag worth of loot from his storage unit and can steal his Vapid 32 Hustler
 If You Choose Don’t Trust Halifax 
It plays out the same as the Reject choice below.
 If You Choose Reject 
 Jason and Lucia refuse to give Halifax the statue and store it at home. This effectively ends this mission chain, we were unable to find any other use for the statue.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Participate Or Don’t Participate In Pool Boy Scene
 During Chapter 3, Jason has the opportunity to participate in a poolside scene with some actors and a director.
 If You Choose Participate 
You will immediately lose romance points with Lucia. The rest of the mission plays out the same.
 If You Choose Don’t Participate 
Jason declines to get further involved and makes an excuse to head into the house. You locate the safe, strip it from the wall, and escape with the objective.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Ask For Help Or Go Solo When Dealing With Towers
 When Jason and Lucia need to put the devices into the communication tower
 Ask For Help 
Lucia and Jason will both climb a tower each; you get a relationship boost. This also allows you to clear all 3 towers. This gives you more time in the bank; it’s the best choice.
 Go Solo 
Jason will need to climb both towers by himself; you will lose some relationship with Lucia. You will only be able to clear two of the three towers doing it solo.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Kill Or Spare Felipe
 During the bank heist, Lucia and Jason’s getaway driver Felipe, bails during the mission, leaving the group without a driver. Later, they are tasked with tracking him down and dealing with the situation. After a brief chase scene, Lucia or Jason have the option of either sparing Felipe or killing him
 If You Kill Felipe 
Felipe is dead and you are given $20,000 cash in your Buckme account
 If You Spare Felipe 
Felipe leaves and Jason and Lucia lie to Andrea, saying there was no trace of Felipe at the location. Later, Felipe will contact you via text and tell thank you for sparing him, offering a Felipe’s 80 Impaler Declasse at the Lost Heaven Cemetery.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Minor Truth Or Brutal Truth Lucia Cellerica
 During Lucia’s initiation into Cellerica in GTAVI, she is given a choice when in the circle of truth. She can choose to either reveal a Minor Truth or a Brutal Truth to the group.
 If You Choose Minor Truth 
Lucia shares an event from high school, the group laughs.
 If You Choose Brutal Truth 
 Lucia tells the group she thinks the group is stupid, Andy tells Lucia to stop because she’s embarrassing her. The group leader tells the rest that Lucia doesn’t understand the process, and asks one of the others to reveal a truth instead.
 Lucia can then defuse or provoke the entire group. If she defuses, the group finishes the ceremony as normal. If she provokes, there’s a scrap first.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Accept Or Refuse Steroids With Lucia
 During Chapter 4, Lucia goes undercover with the gym rats. During the montage section, she has a choice of taking or refusing steroids.
 Accept The Steroids
 If Lucia accepts the steroids, it changes her muscle type to Enhanced in the fitness app. This allows Lucia to go beyond the normal 4/4 body rating, up to 5/5.
 Refuse The Steroids
 Lucia refuses to take the steroids; no serious consequence.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 He Deserves It Or He’s Not Worth It
 During a Lucia mission where she has to pick up her friend Shayna from prison, there’s a choice. During the mission, Lucia takes Shayna to her boyfriend’s house.When the two arrive, they discover the boyfriend asleep on the couch. 
 After Shayna wakes him, another woman enters from a different room. Shayna learns that her boyfriend has been telling people she died in prison.
 She grabs a gun off the table and threatens her boyfriend. Lucia can then make one of two choices.
 If You Choose He’s Not Worth It 
 Lucia tells Shayna that he’s not worth going back to prison for. Shayna doesn’t shoot him, tells him to make the sale, and says she’ll keep the money.
 The buyers come in and will kill Shayna and her boyfriend unless Lucia intervenes. If she does, she and Shayna escape with the stash.
 If You Choose He Deserves It 
 Lucia tells Shayna to hurry up and do what she’s gotta do. After a bit of back and forth, Shayna shoots her boyfriend several times.
 The buyers come in and threaten to kill Shayna, and will kill her if Lucia doesn’t intervene. Lucia then has to kill the drug dealers and can take the stash
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Accept Or Decline Drugs From Andres
 During the Chapter 4 mission Adventures In Babysitting, where Jason takes Andres to the club, Andres offers him drugs.
 If You Accept 
 Jason accepts the drugs and starts to trip during the following fighting scenes. It’s a cool effect; otherwise, no real change.
 If You Decline 
Jason declines the drugs and the event plays out as normal.
 ⮝ Return to Choice Search ⮝
 Cover For Gene Or Snitch On Gene
 During Chapter IV of Grand Theft Auto VI, one of the random events Jason and Lucia can encounter is a naked man screaming on the side of the road. If you pick him up, you learn he had a crazy night with some girls, and they stole his wallet, clothes, and credit cards.
 When you drive him back to his house, his wife is already home. That’s when you get to choose how to handle the situation
 If You Choose Cover For Gene 
 Jason or Lucia backs up Genes story and his wife buys it. Gene then gives a Luxury Watch, which is part of the Progress > Collections > Exploration challenges.
 If You Choose Snitch On Gene
